title_en: Fall 2026 Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project): Schedule and Final Poster Date Change
summary: Students taking the Fall 2026 Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project course) must attend every scheduled session at 18:30 sharp, since two absences or late arrivals result in an F. They must submit the final poster PDF by 23:59 on Monday, November 9, and have their thesis draft reviewed by their graduation project advisor by 23:59 on Monday, November 16. The final poster presentation has been moved to Friday, November 20, 09:30–16:30, in the first-floor corridor, and full-day attendance is required.
applies_to: Students taking the Fall 2026 Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project course) and the laboratories they applied to, including each student's project teaching assistant, for whom attendance at sessions 2 and 3 is mandatory (at least one per laboratory). It also applies to the teaching assistants separately selected to run presentation sessions 2 and 3. Attendance at all scheduled sessions is mandatory for students.

conditions: You are assigned to the project only if the interview confirmation form is submitted to the Room 308 office and you complete course registration; if either is missing, you cannot take the course.
If you drop the course during the semester after submitting the interview confirmation form (for example, because of a leave of absence), you must inform the department office.
Project title changes in the intranet system are accepted only until Friday, August 28.
If your project title or teaching assistant changes after the semester starts, you must inform the department office.
If the project title changes during the semester, both the old and new titles will appear on the final presentation evaluation sheet; this does not affect the grade.
Project titles cannot be changed after the first session.
Attendance at the scheduled sessions is required; there are no other sessions.
One absence lowers your grade by one step (for example, A+ to A0).
Two absences (or late arrivals) result in an F.
Lateness is not excused unless the reason can be proven with documents; traffic congestion is not accepted, so arrive early.
Presenting students must attend session 4 and all presentation sessions.
Each laboratory must send at least one student teaching assistant to sessions 2 and 3; teaching assistants need not attend session 1.
Final poster presentation requires attendance for the whole day (09:30–16:30).

steps: Students: Meet your professor, then make sure the interview confirmation form is delivered to the department office (Building 301, Room 308), and complete course registration for the Electrical Engineering Design Project course.
Students: Check regularly the email address you wrote on the interview confirmation form and the department website notices; module lists were sent to you individually by email.
Students: If your project title or teaching assistant changes, or you drop the course, inform the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
Students: Attend session 1, the "Overview of Thesis Writing" lecture, on Friday, September 11, 18:30–20:30, in Building 301, Room 102, arriving before roll call at 18:30.
Students: Prepare the session 2 and 3 module presentations together with the laboratory you applied to (about 10 minutes per project).

Students: Attend session 2 (Thursday, October 8, 18:30) and session 3 (Thursday, November 5, 18:30) in your module's room: Semiconductor 1 – 301-202; Semiconductor 2 – 301-818; Electrical Energy – 301-103; Electrophysics – 301-104; Communications – 301-201; Control – 301-302; Computer 1 – 301-102; Computer 2 – 301-118; Bio – 301-106.
Students: Just before presenting, hand your presentation file on a USB drive to the session teaching assistant.
Students: Submit the final poster file (PDF, A1 size, portrait) by Monday, November 9, 23:59; the notice does not state where to submit it.
Students: Write your thesis draft and have it reviewed by your graduation project advisor by Monday, November 16, 23:59.
Students: Attend the final poster presentation for the whole day on Friday, November 20, 09:30–16:30, in the first-floor corridor.
Students: Wait for a later notice on graduation thesis submission.
Project teaching assistants: Check project title changes in the intranet system by Friday, August 28, together with the laboratory head.
Project teaching assistants: Ensure at least one teaching assistant per laboratory attends sessions 2 and 3.
Session teaching assistants: Arrive at the classroom 15 minutes before the start and finish setting up the laptop and projector.
Session teaching assistants: Take attendance at 18:30 sharp.
Session teaching assistants: By the next morning, submit the paper attendance sheet with students' and teaching assistants' lateness and absences to the department office (Building 301, Room 308).
translation:
[Fall 2026] Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) Information – Final Poster Presentation Date Changed to 11.20 (Fri)

We announce the basic schedule of the Fall 2026 Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project course) as follows.
Please check regularly the notice emails (sent to the email address you wrote on the interview confirmation form you submitted) and the website notices.
The list for each module has been sent to you individually by email.

- Students and laboratories applying for the Fall graduation project: after meeting the professor, the interview confirmation form [면담확인서] must be delivered to the staff member in charge (Room 308 office) for assignment to be made, and the student must also complete course registration. (If either is missing, you cannot take the course.)
  If, after submitting the interview confirmation form, you drop the course during the semester because of a leave of absence or similar, you must also let us know.
- Project title changes in the intranet system will be accepted until Friday, August 28. (To be checked by the laboratory head and teaching assistant.)
- If, after the semester starts, the project title or teaching assistant changes unavoidably, you must inform the staff member in charge (contact details in the original notice).
  In particular, if the project title is changed during the semester, both the old and new titles will be shown on the final presentation evaluation sheet.
  This will not affect your grade, but please note it. Project titles cannot be changed after the first session.

<Students and Project Teaching Assistants>
※ Attendance at the sessions announced below is required; there are no other sessions.
※ Students who are absent (or late) twice will receive an F, so you must attend. (1 absence: one-step grade deduction, A+ → A0; 2 absences: F.)
※ Roll call is at 18:30 sharp. Every year some students fail to earn the credit because of attendance problems, so please be careful.
※ Lateness is difficult to excuse unless the reason can be supported by documents. Some students arrive late due to traffic congestion and then appeal, so please arrive early.
※ Students must prepare the module presentations for sessions 2 and 3 together with the laboratory they applied to, communicating with it.
※ The presentation sessions 2 and 3 are held in separate classrooms by module, and each project presents for about 10 minutes.
※ Presenting students should hand their presentation file (USB) to the session teaching assistant for that session just before presenting.
※ Presenting students must attend session 4 and all presentation sessions, and student teaching assistants must attend presentation sessions 2 and 3, at least one per laboratory.
   (Teaching assistants do not need to attend session 1, the "Overview of Thesis Writing" lecture.)
※ If, after the semester starts, the project title or teaching assistant changes unavoidably, you must inform the staff member in charge (contact details in the original notice).

<Session Teaching Assistants for Presentation Sessions 2 and 3>
※ Session teaching assistants will be contacted and selected separately.
※ Session teaching assistants must arrive at the classroom 15 minutes before the start, finish setting up the laptop and projector, and check attendance at 18:30 sharp.
 Please report students' and teaching assistants' lateness and absences to the staff member in charge by the following morning. (A paper attendance sheet must be submitted / submit to the office in Building 301, Room 308.)

<Time and Schedule> Check the schedule changes highlighted in yellow. (The yellow highlighting could not be read in the text version.)
- Session 1: "Overview of Thesis Writing" special lecture – Friday, September 11, 18:30–20:30 ※ Check the day of the week
- Session 2: Midterm presentation – Thursday, October 8, 18:30
- Session 3: Midterm presentation – Thursday, November 5, 18:30
- Final poster file submission (PDF for the final presentation, A1 size, portrait) – by Monday, November 9, 23:59
- Write the thesis draft and have it reviewed (must be reviewed by your graduation project advisor) – by Monday, November 16, 23:59
- Final poster presentation – Friday, November 20, 09:30–16:30 ※ Full-day attendance
- Graduation thesis submission – To be announced later

<Presentation Rooms by Module for Sessions 2 and 3> – Semiconductor 2 module added
- Semiconductor 1: Building 301, Room 202
- Semiconductor 2: Building 301, Room 818
- Electrical Energy: Building 301, Room 103
- Electrophysics: Building 301, Room 104
- Communications: Building 301, Room 201
- Control: Building 301, Room 302
- Computer 1: Building 301, Room 102
- Computer 2: Building 301, Room 118
- Bio: Building 301, Room 106

* Note
- Session 1: same classroom regardless of module (Building 301, Room 102)
- Session 4: the final presentation is in the first-floor corridor

※ Inquiries: Undergraduate department office (Building 301, Room 308). The staff member's contact details are in the original notice.
